state_resolution_check.note: Every sample is confirmed to resolve to BED_READY via the real determine_readiness_state() function shipped in the app.

methodology: Paired synthetic simulation: identical exit/cleaning durations drawn per case for both conditions; only the visibility-dependent notice delay and bed-confirmation lag differ between BASELINE and PROTOTYPE. Outcomes are confirmed by calling the app's actual determine_readiness_state() and get_freshness_status() functions, not a separately re-derived formula.
